neighbours.label: ' data' or ' information' immediately after ' personal' ('personal data', 'personal information'); quiet on either word alone and on 'personal' + another noun
fire: The bank must protect the personal data of its customers.
Never post personal information on a public forum.
The app collects personal data without asking first.
Hackers stole personal information from the hospital.
You may ask us to delete your personal data at any time.
The form asks for personal information such as your address.
Schools hold a lot of personal data about their pupils.
The clerk refused to give out personal information by phone.
quiet: The bank must protect the survey data of its customers.
Never post contact information on a public forum.
The app collects weather data without asking first.
Hackers stole personal savings from the hospital staff.
You may ask us to delete your personal account at any time.
The form asks for general information such as opening hours.
Schools hold a lot of personal letters from their pupils.
The clerk refused to give out private records by phone.
